parameters.name: id_token
parameters.description: The ID token received from the OIDC provider, used to sign the user out of the OIDC provider as well

parameters.name: refresh_token
parameters.description: The refresh token received from the OIDC provider, used to obtain a new access token without requiring the user to re-authenticate

200.description: Successfully obtained a new access token, the response body will contain the new token information

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: The authorization code received from the OIDC provider after a successful authentication

parameters.name: redirect_url
parameters.description: The redirect URL used in the authentication request, must match the one used in the initial request

401.description: Failed to get token from OIDC provider, check the response body for more details
